args.title: Fix missing detection of overlapping duplicate days in dedupe
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The deduplication logic in dedupe.ts currently misses the case where two statement files with overlapping days are uploaded together. This results in days appearing twice in the ledger without recognizing duplicates, as described in the issue. 

This pull request proposes a fix to the deduplication process to correctly handle overlapping days in such uploads, ensuring that duplicates across multiple statements in quick succession are detected and filtered out properly.
